rule: Render-noise check with the released version of the cavity (with floor relief) for two cases of the multi-illumination aerial set (block C): flat outcrop v4_26120001, camera c0, illumination q0, and standalone ('isolated') outcrop v4_26130000, camera c1, illumination q1. spp4096: the render specification of the frame was rendered twice (noise_s0 and noise_s1, render seeds 0 and 1) at 4096 samples per pixel with nothing else changed; p999 is the noise measure T of the two renders over the pixels that are rock in both, and pass_noise states T <= 2. spp1024_seed_pair: the same measure for the two frames of block C at this viewpoint and illumination that differ only in the render seed (seed 0, and the repeat _r1 with seed 1; 1024 samples per pixel); no new render. box: the values of the same two cases with the earlier version of the cavity with a flat floor. RGB_used: number of images rendered in this series of runs when the record was written.
